name: flight-recorder
description: Offline-first iPad flight communication and cruise-check recorder.

scripts.check:js: node --check restored_webarchive/app.js && node --check restored_webarchive/sw.js && node --check scripts/verify_local_only_guards.mjs && node --check scripts/apply_submission_values.mjs && node --check scripts/verify_xcode_archive.mjs && node --check scripts/verify_device_test_results.mjs && node --check scripts/report_app_store_status.mjs
scripts.ios:build:sim: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:build:device:unsigned: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:archive:unsigned: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS" -archivePath build/Archives/FlightRecorder-v1.0-b3.xcarchive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO archive
